concept: Map dataset columns into domain-specific case fields

sourceRefs.rationale: Case fields are authored mappings over contributing dataset columns.

goodFor: Explain configurable case fields backed by datasets
Show source identifiers and label fields explicitly
limits: Mapping is not entity resolution, a reasoning engine or manual-field persistence.

reason: Field correspondence is already schema-mapping; entity-grain assembly is separately new.
